cs.t: Hi - congrats on your amazing looking product and experience! I just purchased an Ergatta 2 weeks ago, waiting for delivery.  In what circumstances would I want your product instead of the Ergatta? Background: I'm an avid peloton user for 3 years now, (also just picked up the tempo.fit for guided lifting) and am looking to mix in intense rowing sessions.  The Ergatta looks compelling for gamified sessions with competition. Change my mind?
cs.th: Launch HN: Aviron (YC W21) – High-Intensity Peloton for Rowing
